Red: failed Dexterity save deals 12d6 Fire damage; successful save deals half damage.
Orange: failed Dexterity save deals 12d6 Acid damage; successful save deals half damage.
Yellow: failed Dexterity save deals 12d6 Lightning damage; successful save deals half damage.
Green: failed Dexterity save deals 12d6 Poison damage; successful save deals half damage.
Blue: failed Dexterity save deals 12d6 Cold damage; successful save deals half damage.

Indigo: failed Dexterity save gives Restrained. At the end of each turn, make a Constitution save; three successes end Restrained, and three failures give Petrified until freed by an effect such as Greater Restoration. Successes and failures need not be consecutive and are tracked until either reaches three.

Violet: failed Dexterity save gives Blinded, then the target makes a Wisdom save at the start of the caster's next turn. Success ends Blinded; failure ends Blinded and teleports the target to a GM-chosen plane.
Special: target is struck by two rays; roll twice and reroll any 8.
Red: failed Dexterity save deals 12d6 Fire damage; successful save deals half damage. Blocks nonmagical ranged attacks. Destroyed by taking at least 25 Cold damage.
Orange: failed Dexterity save deals 12d6 Acid damage; successful save deals half damage. Blocks magical ranged attacks. Destroyed by a strong wind such as Gust of Wind.
Yellow: failed Dexterity save deals 12d6 Lightning damage; successful save deals half damage. Destroyed by taking at least 60 Force damage.
Green: failed Dexterity save deals 12d6 Poison damage; successful save deals half damage. Destroyed by Passwall or another spell of equal or greater level that can open a portal on a solid surface.
Blue: failed Dexterity save deals 12d6 Cold damage; successful save deals half damage. Destroyed by taking at least 25 Fire damage.

Indigo: failed Dexterity save gives Restrained. At the end of each turn, make a Constitution save; three successes end Restrained, and three failures give Petrified until freed by an effect such as Greater Restoration. Results need not be consecutive and are tracked until either reaches three. Blocks spellcasting through the layer. Destroyed by Bright Light shed by Daylight.

Violet: failed Dexterity save gives Blinded, then the target makes a Wisdom save at the start of the caster's next turn. Success ends Blinded; failure ends Blinded and teleports the target to a GM-chosen plane. Destroyed by Dispel Magic.
No action; use all movement. Direction is 1d4: 1 north, 2 east, 3 south, 4 west.
No movement; Attack action for one melee attack against a random creature within reach. No action if none is within reach.
